line: Founder... no. Commander. You found my stones once, a long time ago. I remember your voice.
In the age of empires, your people held the seals. That's why there is still a door to guard.
In the age of empires, some seals held and some cracked. I remember every one of them.
In the age of empires, the seals cracked. We've been paying for it ever since. Let's do better this time.
